'''Prologue''' can refer to the following:

* ''[[The Eye of the World/Ravens|Ravens]]'' - a second prologue added to the young adult version of ''The Eye of the World''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Prologue|In the Shadow]]'' - the prologue of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Prologue|Fortress of the Light]]'' - the prologue of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* ''[[The Fires of Heaven/Prologue|The First Sparks Fall]]'' - the prologue of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.
* ''[[Lord of Chaos/Prologue|The First Message]]'' - the prologue of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
* ''[[A Crown of Swords/Prologue|Lightnings]]'' - the prologue of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.
* ''[[The Path of Daggers/Prologue|Deceptive Appearances]]'' - the prologue of ''[[The Path of Daggers]]''.
* ''[[Winter's Heart/Prologue|Snow]]'' - the prologue of ''[[Winter's Heart]]''.
* ''[[Crossroads of Twilight/Prologue|Glimmers of the Pattern]]'' - the prologue of ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]''.
* ''[[Knife of Dreams/Prologue|Embers Falling on Dry Grass]]'' - the prologue of ''[[Knife of Dreams]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Prologue|What the Storm Means]]'' - the prologue of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.
* ''[[Towers of Midnight/Prologue|Distinctions]]'' - the prologue of ''[[Towers of Midnight]]''.
* ''[[A Memory of Light/Prologue|By Grace and Banners Fallen]]'' - the prologue of ''[[A Memory of Light]]''.
